title: Think agent starts with an empty workspace after moving from @cloudflare/shell to @cloudflare/computer
symptoms: Agent files are missing after upgrading Think
Workspace is empty although the old data still exists in the Durable Object SQLite tables
cause: @cloudflare/computer stores files in different tables than @cloudflare/shell and there is no automatic migration. @cloudflare/shell and Think's createExecuteTool are deprecated as of 2026-10-20.
fix: Copy existing files into the new workspace with the migration script in the official guide before switching. Add WorkerJavaScriptBackend if you need JS execution.
affected: Think and Agent Skills using @cloudflare/shell, from 2026-10-20
